name: Cream Cakes
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: wine glass of strong yeast
ingredients.originalText: one wine glass of strong yeast

instructions.text: Beat three eggs very light, stir them into a quart of cream alternately with a quart of sifted flour
Add one wine glass of strong yeast, and a salt-spoon of salt
Cover the batter, and set it near the fire to rise
When it is quite light, stir in a large table-spoonful of butter that has been warmed by the fire
Bake the cakes in muffin rings, and send them to table hot, split with your fingers, and buttered

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat three eggs very light, stir them into a quart of cream alternately with a quart of sifted flour
2. Add one wine glass of strong yeast, and a salt-spoon of salt
3. Cover the batter, and set it near the fire to rise
4. When it is quite light, stir in a large table-spoonful of butter that has been warmed by the fire
5. Bake the cakes in muffin rings, and send them to table hot, split with your fingers, and buttered
